title: fix(cli): a direct os serve --dev compiles the config before its dev artifact door serves it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XVivP8oT7gawhLRoP3Mv7si)_

Fixes #26242

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What was wrong

A host config's dev boot holds two copies of one stack. The config module, evaluated in the serving process, feeds the AppPlugin wrap, and provider-bound connectors are materialized from that copy, so it is what dispatch calls. The compiled `dist/objectstack.json` feeds the dev artifact door, and its copy is what `/api/v1/meta/connector/NAME` serves. #26130 (PR #26240) made `os dev` compile before it boots. A direct `os serve --dev` still composed the door over whatever artifact was on disk, so an env-derived value differed between the two copies.

Red first on `main` at `81bba6c3` (before #26240) and re-read on this branch's base `3d50a43b`: `examples/app-showcase`, artifact compiled with `OS_PORT`/`PORT` unset (all three `baseUrl` values `http://127.0.0.1:3000`), `OS_PORT=41302`, nothing listening on 3000. "dispatch" is `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_declarative_connector_ping/trigger`.

| boot | `/meta/connector/showcase_status_api` → `providerConfig.baseUrl` before | after | dispatch |
|---|---|---|---|
| `os serve objectstack.config.ts --dev -p 41302` | `http://127.0.0.1:3000` | `http://127.0.0.1:41302` | 200, `status: ok` (reached 41302) both |
| `os serve objectstack.config.ts -p 41302` (production) | `http://127.0.0.1:41302` | `http://127.0.0.1:41302`, artifact md5 unchanged | 200 both |
| `os dev --no-compile --no-watch -p 41302` | `http://127.0.0.1:3000` | `http://127.0.0.1:3000` (unchanged, the operator's shortcut) | 200 |
| `os dev --no-watch -p 41302` | (`:41302` since #26240) | `http://127.0.0.1:41302` | 200 |
| `os serve --dev` with `OS_ARTIFACT_URL=file://…` (pinned) | boots the pinned artifact | same, no compile line, pinned file md5 unchanged | |

## The fix

Route (b), the one #26240 took: the dev boot compiles the config into the artifact it is about to serve, in its own environment, so both copies are one evaluation's answer. Nothing restates which variables a config reads or in what order.

- `packages/cli/src/utils/dev-compile-at-boot.ts` (new): `devCompilesAtBoot`, moved verbatim from `commands/dev.ts` so both doors read the one decision (`dev.ts` imports `serve.ts`, so `serve.ts` cannot import `dev.ts`). `dev.ts` now imports it; the decision and its `os dev` behaviour are unchanged. The `#26130` pin's import moves with it.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`: in the dev artifact door's existing-artifact branch, before the door is constructed, a boot with no supervising `os dev` (its channel `OS_INTERNAL_ARTIFACT_PATH` unset) asks `devCompilesAtBoot` and compiles. Under `os dev` the child keeps its parent's decision, so `os dev --no-compile` still serves the artifact as built and a default `os dev` does not compile twice. A boot with no artifact on disk never reaches this branch: no door composes, the wrap is the one copy, and nothing is compiled (so test fixtures and fresh checkouts without `dist/` are untouched). A failed compile refuses the boot with the compile's own output, as under `os dev`. Production boots never reach the branch (it is inside the `isDev` door block).
- `compileForDevBoot` (same util) spawns `os compile CONFIG --output ARTIFACT` with the serving process's environment, including the `.env` files serve loaded, but with `NODE_ENV` put back to its launch value. `serve --dev` sets `NODE_ENV=development` on itself; if the child inherited that, it would run under oclif's source loader, which `child-env-source-loader.pin.test.ts` forbids. The child therefore sees what `os dev`'s compile child sees.
- Cost: one compile per direct dev boot over an existing artifact. On the showcase, ready went from 5 s to 8 s.

## Tests

- New `packages/cli/test/serve-dev-connector-env-parity.integration.test.ts` (integration tier, built entry, `-p 0`). It uses the #26130 fixture, copied so neither file's legs move the other's (#26268 is reworking that file for the port flag). The fixture has one provider-bound connector whose `baseUrl` is built from `OS_PORT`, a provider factory that records the materialized `providerConfig`, and a `:3000` artifact rewritten before each boot. Three legs:
  - `os serve --dev`: the served `baseUrl` equals the materialized one and is not the build-time one.
  - `os dev --no-compile`: the served one is still `:3000` and the artifact's bytes are untouched.
  - Production `os serve`: the materialized one is not `:3000` and the artifact's bytes are untouched.

  The verdicts compare the two copies, never a port number, so the file holds whether or not #26268 has landed. Three runs: `Tests 3 passed (3)` at 13.6 s, 13.9 s and 13.2 s. The header declares `test-budget: 20`, from the slowest run x 1.25.
- `dev-connector-env-parity.integration.test.ts` (#26130's file) is unchanged and green at head. Together with the new file: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 5 passed (5)`.
- Ablation, run once per behaviour through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each leg rebuilt the CLI, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in `packages/cli/dist/commands/serve.js` before the run:
  - A: the compile condition was short-circuited to false. Only the `serve --dev` leg went red, with `expected 'http://127.0.0.1:3000' to be 'http://127.0.0.1:41302'`.
  - B: the supervised guard was dropped. Only the `--no-compile` leg went red, with `expected 'http://127.0.0.1:41302' to be 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'`.
  - Both restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. After a rebuild, `preflight --absent` passed for both markers.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` at `ca2e4216`: `Test Files 334 passed (334)`, `Tests 4878 passed (4878)`. The later commits change one refusal string and one test header.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration` at `378de620` (the first head; the later diff moves the compile spawn into the util and splits the pin out): `Test Files 173 passed | 1 skipped (174)`, `Tests 1477 passed | 9 skipped`. This tier was run because the diff touches the serve boot path, and every direct-dev fixture that has a `dist/` now compiles at boot.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0 at head.

## Gates

Local subset at head `6f7edd28c`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 91 families, and each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: `91 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, all exit 0.

- First sweep, at `ca2e4216`:
  - `pnpm check:doc-authoring` went red on a real finding: the compile refusal's runtime text carried the tracker id. It was stripped (`751f30aa`) and the gate is green.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone. After `git fetch origin 621a4876` it exited 0 (48 cases).
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 there, with its prerequisite not met. It exited 0 on the final sweep.
- `pnpm check:cli-test-child-env`: green with the new census entry, and its self-test passed 152 cases. The first attempt was refused because the leg env's spread came after `NODE_ENV`; `NODE_ENV: undefined` now comes last.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the six touched source and test files: exit 0. `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0.
- CI check-runs: in progress at PR open. The seat reads convergence.

## Acceptance notes

- Open overlap re-measured before opening: #26268 (the `-p` port flag; it touches `dev.ts`, `serve.ts` and #26130's test file), #26244 and #26215 (`serve.ts`, other regions). A trial merge of #26268 into this head is clean. On the merged tree with the CLI rebuilt, both parity files answer `Tests 6 passed (6)`; there `-p 0` makes the config read `:0`, and the relative verdicts still hold. Whichever of the two lands second merges `main`.
- Outside the claim's file surface: none. Docs untouched: no flag or default changed. The `os serve --dev` bullet in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` says nothing about the artifact, so it is not false.
- A non-host config (no plugin instances) on `os serve --dev` never reaches this door: its standalone stack serves metadata and dispatch from the same artifact bundle, so the two copies already agree, both at the build-time value. That is the same posture as `os start --artifact`. It was observed only, not measured on a fixture, and is not this card.
- `NODE_ENV=development os serve` (no `--dev`) is a dev boot too (`isDevelopmentBoot`), composes the same door, and so compiles the same way. `os start` with `NODE_ENV=development` is supervised and does not.
